title: PRAY THIS AT SUNRISE AND TAKE AUTHORITY OVER THE NEXT 48 HOURS
text: Father, we give you thanks. We thank you because you are life. We thank you because you are present. We thank you because you are not a memory and you are not an idea. You are God mighty, near and involved. Someone just woke up and you didn't know why your heart was restless. It is because heaven scheduled this moment. Wherever you are watching from your room, your shop, your office, your phone, lift those hands again. Open your mouth and say Jesus. Take a moment and bless him. Go ahead. Bless him in your own words. Father, we honor you. We magnify you. We declare that you alone are God. From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, your name is to be praised. This morning is not ordinary. This sunrise is not a routine. This is a gate. Someone share this right now. Share it to one person, one group, one contact. God may use you as the instrument that changes a life forever. Stay with me. Don't rush. Begin to worship. You are alpha. You are omega. You are the beginning without beginning. You are the end without an end. There is no shadow you cannot light up. There is no mountain you cannot level. There is no door you cannot open. Father, we worship you. We worship you not because everything is perfect. We worship you because you are perfect. We worship you not because we understand. We worship you because you are faithful. Holy Spirit, breathe on this moment. Someone is crying quietly. God says, "I see you." Someone is confused about today. God says, "I go ahead of you." Someone fears the next 24 hours. God says, "I am already there." We worship you. Take another 30 seconds and just adore him. No prayer yet. Just worship. You are worthy. You are worthy. You are worthy. Let your heart stay there. Now listen, there is a mystery about mornings. There is a mystery about sunrise. The Bible says in Psalm 19 verses 2, "Day unto day utter speech and night unto night reveals knowledge." Meaning time speaks. Every day is a voice. Every sunrise carries an instruction. Every 24 hours is a territory. If you don't speak first, something else will speak. If you don't take authority, something else will attempt control. Psalm 118 verses 24 says, "This is the day which the Lord has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it." Notice the day already exists, but dominion must be enforced. Genesis 1 verses 28 says, "And God blessed them. And God said unto them, have dominion." Dominion is not automatic. It is commanded. Job 38 verses 12 says, "Has thou commanded the morning since thy days began and [clears throat] caused the day spring to know his place?" Meaning mornings respond to command. Hear me carefully, the next 24 hours are not neutral. They can either favor you or fight you. They can either cooperate or resist, but scripture gives us authority. Luke 10 verses 19 says, "Behold, I give unto you power to tread upon serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy and nothing shall by any means hurt you. Nothing. Not today. Not this morning. Not in the next 24 hours." Ecclesiastes 8 verses 4 says, "Where the word of a king is, there is power." You are not praying as a beggar this morning. You are praying as one seated with Christ. Ephesians 2 verses 6 says, "He has raised us up together and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus. >> [music] >> So, when you speak, heaven backs you. Now, listen. Sunrise is a gate. It is a legal moment. It is a shift between darkness and light. Malachi 4:2 says, "Unto you that fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings." So, healing is legal this morning. Restoration is legal this morning. Authority is legal this morning. Now, we pray, but we don't pray casually. We pray with understanding. Lift your right hand and say after me, "Father, in the name of Jesus, by the authority of scripture, I take command of this day." Open your mouth and declare it again. "I take command of this day. I decree that the next 24 hours answer to the will of God concerning my life." Psalm 91:11 says, "He shall give his angels charge over you to keep you in all your ways." So, now declare, "Angels of the living God, take your positions. Go ahead of me. Stand behind me. Stand beside me. I decree divine order over my steps." Proverbs 16:9 says, "A man's heart deviseth his way, but the Lord directs his steps." So, I decree direction, no confusion, no wrong turns, no costly mistakes. Now, lift your voice. "Every power assigned to manipulate my day, I command you to lose your hold now, in the name of Jesus." Psalm 24:7 says, "Lift up your heads, O ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in." So, now speak prophetically. "Gates of this day, gates of my business, gates of my home, gates of my destiny, open by fire. Let favor come in. Let help come in. Let speed come in. Isaiah 45:2 says, "I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight." So, I decree straight paths today. Delays dissolve. Confusion clears. Resistance breaks. Now, pray. Every agenda programmed into this day to drain my virtue, I cancel you by the blood of Jesus. Luke 8:46 says, "Jesus said, 'Somebody has touched me, for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.'" Hear me. Virtue can leak. Time can be stolen. So, now declare, "I recover time. I recover strength. I recover clarity. I recover momentum." Joel 2:25 says, "I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten." Restoration is happening even now. Someone's chest just felt warm. That is the power of God touching you. Someone watching, your name is Emmanuel. The Lord says, "I am giving you clarity before noon." Someone named Grace, a call will come today that shifts your direction. Someone in Lagos, what delayed you last week will cooperate today. Now, lift your voice again. Every evil altar speaking against my family today, I silence you. Judges 6:25 says, "Throw down the altar of Baal." So, I decree altars break. Covenants expire. Patterns end. In my family line, cycles of hardship, cycles of delay, cycles of sickness, I command you to stop today. Psalm 112:2 says, "His seed shall be mighty upon earth." So, I declare my children preserved, my household preserved, my lineage blessed. Now, pray for marriages. Father, by your power, every marriage under pressure receive peace now. Ecclesiastes 4:12 says, "A threefold cord is not quickly broken." So, I decree divine alignment, misunderstanding dissolves, hearts softened, love is restored. For those believing God for marriage, Isaiah 34:16 says, "None shall want her mate." So, I declare divine connection, not delay, not counterfeit, but God-ordained union. Now, finances. Deuteronomy 8:18 says, "It is he that giveth thee power to get wealth." So, I decree financial gates open, ideas activated, help us released, no loss today, no waste today, no devourer today. Malachi 3:11 says, "I will rebuke the devourer for your sake." So, I declare supernatural preservation. Now, health. Jeremiah 30:17 says, "I will restore health unto thee." I speak to everybody watching, every pain, every weakness, every diagnosis by the authority of Jesus, be healed. Someone's headache just left. Someone's stomach just settled. Someone with knee pain, test it now. Now, we enter deeper. Lift both hands. Every witchcraft activity scheduled for today, backfire now. Isaiah 54:17 says, "No weapon formed against thee shall prosper." So, I decree arrows return to sender, enchantments collapse, spells scatter. Psalm 35:8 says, "Let destruction come upon him unawares." Now pray with fire. Every spirit of accident, every spirit of error, every spirit of sudden sorrow, you have no permission. I declare divine preservation. Psalm 121:7 says, "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil." Not some evil, all evil. Now begin to pray in the spirit wherever you are. Shakarababa, leketoshima, rabababa. Let the spirit take over. Do not stop. Rakata paya, zeketele boshia, mantakabala. I see chains breaking. I see light flooding dark spaces. I see doors opening suddenly. Father, we thank you because you never start what you don't intend to finish. You are alpha and you are omega. Someone say, "Lord, finish it." Now listen carefully. There are days that are ordinary and there are days that are armed. Today is armed. Psalm 68:19 says, "Blessed be the Lord who daily loadeth us with benefits." Meaning today already has allocations. But benefits must be enforced. Lift your voice and declare, "I refuse to miss what God loaded into this day." Open your mouth and say it again. "I refuse to miss what God loaded into this day." Now pray. Every veil over my understanding today, tear now. Isaiah 25:7 says, "He will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people." So I declare clarity, sharp discernment, spiritual sensitivity. I will not misread people. I will not misinterpret instructions. I will not misjudge opportunities. Now hear this. Many battles are not loud. They are subtle. They don't shout. They whisper. So, we pray strategically. Lift your right hand. Every spirit assigned to distract me today, lose your influence now. Psalm 32:8 says, "I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go." So, I decree divine focus. No wasted hours. No wasted energy. Someone watching, your name is Daniel. The Lord says what you've been postponing, do it today. I am backing you. Someone named Ruth, a conversation today will unlock speed. Someone in Abuja, the delay is not demonic anymore. It's timing. Move now. Now, pray for your mind. 2 Timothy 1:7 says, "God has not given us the spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind." So, I command anxiety to lift, fear to dissolve, mental heaviness to break. If you've been waking up tired, that cycle ends today. Lift your voice. Every spirit of exhaustion without labor, go now. Isaiah 40:31 says, "They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength." So, I receive renewed strength, fresh fire, fresh grace. Now, let's address time. Time can fight you. Time can betray you, but time can also cooperate. Psalm 90:12 says, "Teach us to number our days that we may apply our hearts onto wisdom." So, I decree wisdom over today. I will be at the right place at the right time doing the right thing. Now, pray this boldly. Every power assigned to waste my time today, be arrested in the name of Jesus. Now, lift both hands. I command divine acceleration. Amos 9:13 says, "The plowman shall overtake the reaper." So, I decree speed without error, progress without regret. What should take weeks collapses into hours. Someone will finish today what you feared would take months. Now, we go deeper. Family patterns don't rest, but neither does covenant. Exodus 20:5 says, "Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children." But, Galatians 3:13 says, "Christ has redeemed us from the curse." So, now declare, "By the blood of Jesus, I disconnect from every inherited limitation." Lift your voice. Patterns of struggle break. Patterns of delay break. Patterns of marital instability break. I establish a new pattern. Psalm 66:12 says, "We went through fire and through water, but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place." So, I decree emergence. Now, marriage is again. Every third voice speaking into your home, be silenced. Mark 10:9 says, "What God has joined together, let not man put asunder." So, I declare unity, peace, restoration for those trusting God for children. Psalm 113:9 says, "He maketh the barren woman to keep house and to be a joyful mother of children." I speak fruitfulness. Now, finances again deeper. Money responds to wisdom and favor. Proverbs 10:22 says, "The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, and he added no sorrow with it." So, I decree sorrow-free increase. No losses attached. No shame attached. Someone's debt will reduce suddenly. Now, health again. Proverbs 4:20-22 says, "They are life unto those that find them and health to all their flesh." So, I speak life into organs. Life into blood. Life into bones. Every hidden infirmity be exposed and flushed out. Now, we address witchcraft again thoroughly. Micah 5:12 says, "I will cut off witchcraft out of thine hand." So, now declare every monitoring spirit lose signal. Every evil mirror and shatter. Every midnight manipulation expire in the name of Jesus. Now, pray in the spirit again. Stay there. I see a woman watching. You've had strange dreams repeatedly. The Lord says they stop from today. I see a man, your name is Samuel. Paperwork delayed. God says by evening, check again. Now, we seal the day. Lift your right hand. I decree no bad news today. No emergency today. No sudden sorrow today. Psalm 112:7 says, "He shall not be afraid of evil tidings." So, I walk in peace. I decree favor before men. Favor before systems. Favor before authorities. Psalm 5:12 says, "Thou Lord will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass him as with a shield." So, I am shielded. Now, say this with authority. The siege is over. The resistance is broken. The day is secured. I walk into favor. I walk into help. I walk into results. My destiny is preserved. My family is preserved. My steps are ordered. >> [music] >> This week will testify of me. Now seal it in the spirit. Shakara baba. Le keto shima. Mantaka bala. Victory. Victory. Victory. In Jesus mighty name. Amen. Now listen carefully. There are battles you win by praying. There are battles you win by alignment. And there are battles you win by enforcement. This morning is about enforcement. Matthew 11:12 says, "From the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffered violence and the violent take it by force." Meaning some things will not yield until you insist. Lift your voice. I insist on God's will for my life today. Say it again with fire. I insist on God's will for my life today. Now pray this. Every resistance standing between me and obedience [music] collapse now in the name of Jesus. Some of you is not demons fighting you. It's hesitation. It's delay. It's second guessing. James 1:6 says, "Let him ask in faith nothing wavering." So I decree decisiveness. No more double mind. No more inner conflict. I receive bold obedience today. Someone watching your name is Michael. The Lord says take this step I will meet you there. Now lift your hands. We address spiritual covering. Psalm 125:2 says, "As the mountains around about Jerusalem so the Lord is round about his people." So I decree divine covering over you today. Where you go God goes. Where you stand God stands. No stray arrows. No random attacks. Now speak this prophetically. I am hidden in Christ. My life is not exposed. Colossians 3:3 says, "Your life is hid with Christ in God." So, [music] I decree invisibility to evil eyes. Every eye assigned to study my movement today be blinded. Every voice assigned to accuse me today be silenced. Revelation 12:10 says, "The accuser of the brethren is cast down." So, I declare accusation overturned. Now we go deeper into destiny alignment. Many people are busy but not fruitful. Active but not impactful. John 15:16 says, "I have chosen you and ordained you that you should go and bring forth fruit." So, I decree [music] purposeful activity today. Every effort yields results. Every seed yields harvest. No labor in vain. 1 Corinthians 15:58 says, "Your labor is not in vain in the Lord." Someone is about to see proof today. Now pray, "Every power assigned to frustrate my efforts scatter now [music] in the name of Jesus." Now finances again, but this time wisdom. Proverbs 21:5 says, "The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness." So, I receive strategic thinking, no impulsive decisions, no financial traps. I hear God clearly concerning money. Someone watching, your name is Esther, the Lord says that expense you are considering, wait, I will provide another way. Now health deeper. Some sicknesses are symptoms, not roots. Exodus 15:26 says, "I am the Lord that healeth thee." So, now pray, "Every root cause of affliction in my body be uprooted now in the name of Jesus. I speak to immune systems. I speak to blood pressure. I speak to hormones, align now. Someone felt heat move from your back to your chest. That is healing. Now, families again, some families are under spiritual siege. Psalm 127:1 says, "Except the Lord build the house, they labor in vain that build it." So, I invite God into my household today. I decree peace where there was tension, understanding where there was silence, love where there was coldness. Every spirit of division leave. Now, spiritual warfare intensifies. Lift your voice. Every covenant speaking against my progress today, break now. Hebrews 9:14 speaks of the blood that purges the conscience. So, I invoke the blood of Jesus over my name, over my records, over my timeline. Blood speaks better things. Now, pray in the spirit again. Don't stop. Rakata payer. Zekotobala. Shanteregakata. I see chains falling. I see documents being approved. I see doors swinging open suddenly. Someone in Port Harcourt a meeting today will shift your status. Someone named Joy, the heaviness lifts before noon. Now, we address destiny helpers. Isaiah 60:10 says, "The sons of strangers shall build up thy walls." So, I decree helpers locate me. Helpers with speed. Helpers with understanding. Helpers without manipulation. No helper will turn into a burden. Now, declare boldly, "I will not walk alone today." Psalm 23:4 says, "Thou art with me." So, I walk with confidence. Now, let's seal against evil surprises. Lift your right hand. Every agenda of sudden loss, cancelled. Every agenda of sudden embarrassment, cancelled. Every agenda of sudden sorrow, cancelled. Job 5:21 says, "Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue." So, I am hidden. Now, joy. The joy of the Lord is not optional, it is strength. Nehemiah 8:10 says, "The joy of the Lord is your strength." So, I receive joy unspeakable. I refuse heaviness. I refuse discouragement. Today, I smile again. Now, speak this final declaration loudly. The day answers to me. The hours cooperate with me. The systems favor me. I walk in victory. I return with testimony. Now, seal it one more time in the spirit. Shakara baba, leketoshima, mantakabala. The fire is sealed. The day is secured in Jesus' mighty name. Amen. Now, listen. There are moments when prayer shifts from asking to declaring. We have crossed that line. From this point, we speak as witnesses of victory. Revelation 12:11 says, "They overcame him by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony." Meaning, testimony can be spoken before it manifests. So, lift your voice and say, "I speak victory before evidence appears." Say it again. "I speak victory before evidence appears." Now, hear this carefully. Some attacks are not frontal. They are ambushes. Psalm 91:3 says, "Surely, he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler." A snare is hidden. So, we pray for exposure. Lift your right hand. Every hidden trap set for me today be exposed and dismantled now in the name of Jesus. I decree no surprises. I decree no sudden traps. I decree no evil detours. Now, pray for your words today. Words [music] can build. Words can destroy. Proverbs 18:21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue." So, I decree my mouth will not betray my destiny today. No careless words. No emotional confessions. No negative declarations. I speak life only. Someone watching, your name is Peter. The Lord says, "Watch your words before noon. I am protecting [music] you." Now, we address relationships. Some doors open through people. Some doors close through people. Psalm 41:9 talks about familiar friends lifting their heel. So, now pray. Every relationship positioned to drain me today [music] be disconnected. And every relationship positioned to help me be activated. In the name of Jesus, I decree discernment. I will know who to speak to. I will know who to keep silent around. Now, destiny again deeper. Destiny is not just future. Destiny speaks daily. Isaiah 30:21 says, "Thine ears shall hear a word behind thee saying, 'This is the way, walk ye in it.'" So, I declare sensitivity. I hear God clearly today. I will not miss divine cues. Someone is about to avoid a costly mistake because of this prayer. Now, lift both hands. We address spiritual exhaustion. Some of you are tired not because of work, but because of warfare. Matthew 11:28 says, "Come unto me, all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. So I receive rest in my soul, rest in my emotions, rest in my thoughts. I lay burdens down. Now finances, again prophetic. Money is not evil, but pressure around money can choke destiny. Psalm 34 verses 10 says, "They that seek the Lord shall not want any good thing." So I decree divine supply today. Unexpected provision, unexpected discounts, unexpected favor. Someone will receive help without asking. Now we confront delay again. Habakkuk 2 verses 3 says, "Though it tarry, wait for it because it will surely come." But there are delays that must be rebuked. So now declare, "Every artificial delay programmed into today expire now. I step into divine timing. No late arrivals, no missed opportunities." Now pray for protection over journeys, whether you are stepping out or staying in. Psalm 121 verses 8 says, "The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in." So I decree safe movements, no accidents, no near misses, no mechanical failures. Angels escort me. Now we go into intense warfare briefly but sharply. Lift your voice. "Every voice speaking against my name in the spirit be silenced." Isaiah 54 verses 17 says, "Every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn." So I condemn accusations, I condemn gossip, I condemn slander. My name is cleared. Now joy again because joy is a weapon. Psalm 16 verses 11 He "In thy presence is fullness of joy." So, I receive divine joy. Heaviness lifts now. If you were feeling low, breathe deeply, joy is entering. Now, final alignment. Lift your right hand and say this slowly. Today, I walk in obedience. I walk in favor. I walk in authority. Nothing will steal my peace. Nothing will steal my focus. Nothing will steal my reward. I decree that before this day ends, I will see evidence, evidence of favor, evidence of help, evidence of progress. Now, seal it with tongues one last time. Shakara baba, leketoshima, mantakabala, rakatapaya. The word has gone forth. The angels are moving. The day is secured. Walk into it boldly in Jesus' mighty name. Amen.
